_doc: OFFLINE LAST-RESORT repo-name equivalence groups for validator_repo_guard.py. PRIMARY mechanism is canonical GitHub identity (gh api repos/<owner>/<name> --jq .node_id), which follows renames automatically and needs NO entry here. Add a group ONLY for a repo gh can no longer resolve at all (deleted/transferred away), or to keep a known rename resolvable when the mini is offline with a cold identity cache. Each inner array is one equivalence group of owner/name spellings that address ONE repository.
